title: Retry low-disk hold-and-resume; fix scope-guard test and decisions entry
summary: Retry of job 20261031-110024-4qd3 (rejected): keep its hold-and-auto-resume work, so low disk after idle-build cleanup before the checks or the verifier holds the job resumable, not failed. Fix its two findings: the stale scope_guard test and the failing backtest from the docs/decisions.md entry. Audience: the maintainer running drains and the verifier running cargo test.

defaults_applied.how: All changes are Rust code and tests.
cargo test, clippy and fmt criteria.
Behavior criteria run drain, binary and backtest tests.
Fix the stale test and the decisions entry that caused the failures.
Criteria check hold, resume and status behavior by running tests.
The outcome is that a full-disk drain never ends a job failed.
Docs and changelog written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs (test a_low_disk_job_is_read_as_an_environment_attempt, line 1375, still asserts Failed and Verdict::Environment, panics because go() now returns the LowDisk hold error); crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs line 337 (the backtest emits 'supersession phrases without a target id', so the decisions.md entry the candidate added near line 3875 uses such a phrase). No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not affected. The property is measured by running the real drain and run tests with ATHENA_FREE_BYTES, not a stand-in.

Job 20261031-110024-4qd3 findings addressed: (a) blocker, stale scope_guard test: rewrite it so go() returns Err LowDisk with no attempt recorded and no outcome, then after space is freed the retry or next go resumes the kept candidate as resumed and lands; (b) failing backtest: reword the docs/decisions.md entry so any supersession phrase names a target decision id, or has none; (c) major, criterion 8 unevidenced: the full cargo test --locked now passes and the recorded check shows it.

Job 20261031-110024-4qd3's candidate changed 16 files. All 16 are kept as deliverables: the hold design is sound, and only the test and the docs fix are new work. The retry starts from the base, so the producer redoes the whole change, guided by the earlier approach: Athena::hold_for_disk commits the attempt's records without a Score or Outcome, writes a hold marker with free and required amounts, and returns LowDisk; drain maps LowDisk to Held with no attempt used; push_closing_records is shared from close.rs.
This is a code change in Rust; no refusal rule is added to readings, so no newly-refused percentage applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A test with simulated low space (ATHENA_FREE_BYTES) after the build shows the job ends held, not Failed, with no `athena retry`, no verifier or producer verdict recorded, and outcome text naming `environment: low disk` with free and required amounts. It fails on pre-change code.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A test shows a later drain pass, after simulated free space is raised, resumes the held job from its kept candidate with no new producer run and no `athena retry`, and the job finishes.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain`. A test shows space that stays short across passes leaves the job held and uses no drain attempt.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core`. Tests show a low-disk hold before the checks and before the verifier is not counted as a work failure in introspection, failure classes or the scope guard. The updated scope_guard test a_low_disk_job_is_read_as_an_environment_attempt passes by asserting go returns the LowDisk hold with no attempt recorded and the later resume lands as resumed. Idle-build cleanup still runs first, and removes only Athena-owned finished-job directories.
Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test binary`. `athena status` shows the held job with its low-disk reason and the amounts.

Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest`. It passes, including the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list, so the docs/decisions.md entry carries no supersession phrase without a target id.

Grep of crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs, run/verification.rs and disk.rs shows the low-disk path no longer builds a failure with a `before the checks` or `before the verifier` message telling the person to run `athena retry`.

CHANGELOG.md has an entry for hold-and-auto-resume; module docs in crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs and crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs describe it instead of fail-and-retry; docs/decisions.md records the call.
Run `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`; all pass with no failing test anywhere in the workspace.
Governance files are unchanged: athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and rust-toolchain.toml are not in the diff.

The budget-cap hold for planner, producer and verifier stages; a separate job
Test-suite speedup and other work of job 20261025-202447-xgk9
Guarding combined disk use of parallel jobs, or planning around disk
Changing the [disk] min_free_gb default or config schema, or editing athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
Deleting committed records or touching a running job's files in the cleanup
Removing `athena retry` or its handling of old failed environment jobs
departures: Larger than reference: 16-file change across core and CLI with a full cold-built test run, and the earlier attempt failed on cross-file tests.
urgent_reason: Stops jobs that fail on low disk and need a manual retry, which wastes failed attempts and retry work.
hard_reason: Changes how a job's run pipeline closes: the free-disk gate before the checks and verifier now holds the job instead of failing it, which touches the drain and the scope guard.
